hypotheses.O0_role_vjps_recompose_native_attention: Q1, K1, Q2, K2, and value VJPs recompose native attention with maximum relative error at most 1e-5, and the all-block recurrence matches direct gradients.
hypotheses.O1_query_roles_are_sufficient: Q1 plus Q2 in Blocks 2 through 9 reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.O2_key_roles_are_insufficient: K1 plus K2 remains below 0.85 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.O3_queries_beat_keys: The query-only program exceeds the key-only program by at least 0.10 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.O4_two_query_factors_are_complementary: Q1 plus Q2 beats the better individual query factor by at least 0.05 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.O5_two_qk_pairs_are_complementary: All QK roles beat the better complete Q1K1 or Q2K2 pair by at least 0.05 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.O6_nonquery_increment_is_limited: The full early program exceeds query-only by less than 0.08 median gradient cosine.
